in_marathi.name: Asraful
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protector of the People
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asraful हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who protects the people from harm and danger. Derived from the Sanskrit words 'astra' (weapon) and 'ful' (protector).

in_bengali.name: Asraful
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Protector of the People
in_bengali.long_meaning: Asraful একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who protects the people from harm and danger. Derived from the Sanskrit words 'astra' (weapon) and 'ful' (protector).
